gates.purpose: Freeze a safe battery keepout and thickness budget.
gates.current_assumption: 301230 nominal 30 x 12 x 3 mm only; the board already carries dedicated BP (BAT_PACK_TBD, d1.5 at 49.5/23.55), BN (GND, d1.5 at 47.7/23.70) and NTC (BAT_NTC_TBD, d1.2 at 45.60/23.70) landing pads next to U2, so only the cell envelope, lead exit and NTC presence are open.
required_evidence: supplier maximum body dimensions including protection board and adhesive
lead exit direction and bend radius
allowed charge/discharge current and NTC requirement
gates.next_action: Measure the received pack or obtain a supplier drawing; update EDA and CAD together.

gates.purpose: Make the PCB outline, USB edge cutout, anchor pads and enclosure opening agree.
gates.current_assumption: E14 still carries the historical board edge and USB candidate geometry.
required_evidence: final J1 drawing and insertion direction
edge slot, anchor and copper clearance accepted by the fabricator
84 x 52 mm outline with tool radius and assembly datum
gates.next_action: Lock J1 mechanical reference, then edit the outline and enclosure datum in one controlled E14 revision.

gates.purpose: Route USB data, VBUS, charger SYS/BAT, 3V3, ground return and EPD signals from the verified netlist.
gates.current_snapshot: Zero copper lines and zero vias; 188 connectivity DRC results are expected.
required_evidence: schematic-to-PCB association rechecked after the final footprint choices
charger, battery and regulator return paths
EPD busy/reset/data lines and local decoupling
gates.next_action: Route critical power and USB nets first, save, reopen and rerun DRC after each block.

gates.purpose: Replace the rectangular NFC reserve with an actual antenna and matching layout.
gates.current_assumption: Upper-right prohibited region is a spatial constraint only.
gates.next_action: Keep the region reserved during routing; do not claim NFC performance until the antenna is measured in the enclosure.

gates.purpose: Turn the spatial study into a manufacturable shell only after the PCB datums are stable.
gates.current_assumption: Current FCStd/STEP is a block-level envelope, not a printable shell.
required_evidence: verified board outline and USB opening
screen window, FPC bend and support
button travel, wall thickness, catches and print clearances
measured battery thickness and strain relief
gates.next_action: Keep the E14 CAD study as a reference and start the shell revision after the outline/USB gate passes.

gates.purpose: Release only a coherent Gerber/Excellon, BOM/CPL and production CAD package.
gates.release_rule: All preceding gates pass, DRC/DFM is reviewed, and the package is saved and reopened from the same E14 revision.
gates.current_snapshot: No Gerber, Excellon, final BOM/CPL, production STEP or printable STL is generated.
gates.next_action: Do not export or send a vendor package from the current snapshot.

ordered_next_actions: Obtain or measure the actual battery envelope and lead/NTC details.
Freeze J1 insertion datum and revise the E14 board outline plus USB opening.
Recheck schematic/PCB associations, then route power and USB critical nets.
Route EPD and control signals, add ground return and validate DRC after save/reopen.
Design NFC antenna and matching after the metal and enclosure boundaries are known.
Convert the CAD envelope into the printable shell and run geometry/visual checks.
Generate the vendor package only after the release gates are green.

V5 uses 0.4 mm bottom plate, 0.5 mm top plate and a 0.5 mm key-cap disc, all below the recommendation; meeting 0.8 mm walls would grow the stack from 4.5 to 5.2 mm, so the sample needs a thinner-capable process or the hybrid thin-sheet cover route. Key-cap radial fit is 0.2 mm, the same order as the printing tolerance.
evidence.nfc_feed: NFC1_TBD/NFC2_TBD have 0 copper segments on the board; U1 pin 52/54 sit at (61.25, 4.05)/(61.25, 3.25) as 0.6 x 0.4 mm top pads. Measured with scripts/report-free-space.py: landing-pad candidate area is the free copper patch south of the keep-out on the bottom layer (x 61.8-71.9, y 21.7-25.9, 42.4 mm2, pads must stay below y=24), feed corridors x 58.4-61.1/y 16.8-18.1 and x 58.8-60.5/y 23.8-25.9, about 19 mm per feed. Pad size/pitch and the matching network depend on the antenna form, which awaits the PN532 bench test.; inductance study (estimate-nfc-coil.py): the 17x21 mm reserve reaches 1.02 uH at 5 turns / 0.25 mm (C 135 pF, Q 127) up to 2.07 uH at 8 turns (C 67 pF, Q 173), so the bench test must answer read range and metal/ferrite loading rather than inductance; a card-sized 60x40 coil would give 2-3 uH with Q up to 219 but needs copper under the screen and MCU; layer choice: top-layer copper sits 3.0 mm from the front face and 1.5 mm from the back, bottom-layer copper is 0.7 mm from the back face, so the pre-study favours a bottom-layer coil unless the bench test needs front-side reading; feeder feasibility (pcb-maze-router.py, 2026-09-23): both nets route to candidate pads at (62.0,22.5)/(64.5,22.5) on the bottom layer - NFC1 18 segments + 1 via, NFC2 12 segments + 5 vias - but the paths split around the U1 module and form a large loop, so the maze result is a feasibility proof, not a recommended layout; the direct corridor (x 59.5-68, y 14-24) is blocked by roughly 40 top-layer and 37 bottom-layer segments from seven nets plus the C5-C7 VDD_3V3 decoupling row, so the antenna pass must also clear a 1.0-1.5 mm paired-feed corridor (re-route a few segments, optionally shift C5-C7 by 2-3 mm); then the two feeds can run side by side at 0.15 mm width / 0.3 mm pitch with no vias

evidence.battery_envelope_limits: battery bite is at its hard limits: east edge can only reach 33.80 mm (SW pads start at x=34.10 with the 0.3 mm copper-to-edge rule), north edge only ~15.02 mm (bottom-layer KEY_PREV_N runs at y=15.40 hugging the bite), pocket height 3.6 mm (0.4 plate to 4.0 ceiling). A cell up to 32.5 x 14 x 3.4 mm still leaves 0.5-1 mm margins; wider than 33.8 mm or taller than 15.02 mm forces moving the key column (about 8 traces) plus a new enclosure version, and thicker than 3.6 mm breaks the 4.5 mm stack
evidence.charger_defaults: BQ25186 charge current is I2C-only (5-1000 mA, 10 mA steps above 40 mA): ICHG_CTRL (0x4) resets to 0x05 = CHG_DIS 0 plus ICHG 5+5 = 10 mA, CHARGECTRL0 (0x5) resets to 0x24 = ITERM 10% of ICHG, IPRECHG 2x ITERM, VINDPM 0b01, THERM_REG 100 C. Out of the box the sample therefore charges at 10 mA (about 0.2C for a 45 mAh cell, ~5 h); firmware should raise ICHGCODE to 15-20 (20-25 mA, about 0.5C) and leave ITERM at 10%.
evidence.epd_bom_review: EPD booster parts checked against the GDEH0154E01 page-8 reference (2026-09-23): D1-D3 MBR0530T1G (30 V/0.5 A, meets reverse>=30 V, Io>=500 mA, Vf<=430 mV), L1 NRH3010T470MN 47 uH (same part as the datasheet), R15 0603WAF220KT5E = 2.2 ohm +/-1% (RESE), R13 100k, R14/R18 10k, R16 0 ohm, R17 3 ohm (BS0 per the DESPI board); decoupling CL21B105KBFNNNE = 1 uF 0805 X7R 50 V (spec asks 1 uF 0603 X5R 25 V, so value and rating exceed it); Q1 Si1308EDL-T1-GE3 vs the datasheet's Si1304BDL/NX3008NBK: Vds 30 V ok, Rds(on) 0.185 ohm max at 2.5 V vs the <=2.1 ohm requirement, Vgs(th) 0.6-1.5 V is 0.2 V above the stated 1.3 V max but still ~1 V of overdrive at 2.5 V, and it is the part the official DESPI-E01 board uses - accepted
evidence.supply_value_review: component values checked against vendor references (2026-09-23): U1 VDD/VDDH has C5 2.2uF + C6 10uF + C7 100nF versus the 10 uF in the Raytac MDBT50Q Rev L reference circuit 8.1; no external 32.768 kHz crystal (internal RC, as the same note allows); DCCH left open for LDO mode so the 10 uH Reg0 inductor is not needed; VBUS carries C1 2.2uF + C8 4.7uF = 6.9 uF nominal, below the USB 2.0 10 uF inrush ceiling and close to the reference value; BQ25186 IN/SYS/BAT = 4.7/10/2.2 uF versus the 1/10/1 uF in its typical application (page 42); TPS7A02 CIN/COUT = 2.2/2.2 uF within 1 uF / 1-22 uF; USB-C CC pull-downs 5.1k +/-1% versus the spec's 5.1k +/-5%; DP/DM series 27 ohm inside the usual 0-33 ohm range; I2C pull-ups 10k within the datasheet's 1-20k
